decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 10.2	The construction of an enlarged basement area with front and rear light wells to the house, as shown on drawing numbers 5425/A/50/01 Revision A, 5425/A/50/03 Revision A, 5425/A/50/04 and 5425/A/50/05, received 13 October 2006 and 5425/A/50/02 Revision A, received 06 December 2006 (Amended Plan), would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the existing street scene and would satisfactorily maintain the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The basement shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the single family house at 40 Airedale Avenue and shall not be used as a separate unit of living accommodation. The rooms proposed will at no time be converted to habitable rooms.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday, and 9.30am to 12.30pm on Saturdays, and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Informative:

Thames Water requests that the applicant should incorporate within their proposal protection to the property by, for example, non- return valve or other suitable device to avoid the risk of backflow at a later date, on the assumption that the sewerage network may surcharge to ground level during storm conditions.
description: Construction of enlarged basement area with front & rear lightwells to house
